beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The form therefore moves between literary inheritance, conceptual comparison, and lived resistance.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its richest question is what escapes an observer's increasingly capable model.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the explanation of the table, then enter the first memorial encounter.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The two modes show why the book needs both system and story.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers interested in worldbuilding can trace how operations combine into new pressures.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers interested in fiction can question the authority of the world-maker.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Neither route requires treating the table as a final inventory of imagination.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book invites invention that remains attentive to what its categories cannot contain.
